mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_stocks ( product_id, stock_quantity, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{stockQuantity}, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id AS productId, stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, version, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM product_stocks WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.update: UPDATE product_stocks SET stock_quantity = #{stockQuantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id AS productId, stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, version, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM product_stocks WHERE product_id = #{productId} FOR UPDATE
